title: Companion Cube (Sulfur Cube)
description: A resource pack that replaces Sulfur Cube with a companion cube
body:
The Sulfur Cube has been… reassigned. Now it's your faithful, walking Companion Cube.
This resource pack replaces the model/texture of the new Sulfur Cube mob with the iconic Companion Cube from Portal 2. It still hops and follows you with silent devotion.

(Warning: The Companion Cube does not love you back. But it will follow you. Maybe.)
